cloudInitNoCloud.userData:
#cloud-config
hostname: referenzvm
manage_etc_hosts: true
disable_root: true
ssh_pwauth: false
package_update: false
package_upgrade: false
users:
  - name: ubuntu
    groups: [sudo]
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    shell: /bin/bash
    lock_passwd: true
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAICDeni6OPrsYaCfeayWMiGPRKbpcOZf+4Q6T+lFv9tAz diplomarbeit-referenz
write_files:
  - path: /var/www/index.html
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      lernumgebung bereit
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/testdienst.service
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=HTTP-Testdienst der Referenz-Lernumgebung
      After=network.target
      [Service]
      User=nobody
      Group=nogroup
      WorkingDirectory=/var/www
      ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /var/www
      Restart=on-failure
      [Install]
      WantedBy=multi-user.target
runcmd:
  - [systemctl, daemon-reload]
  - [systemctl, enable, --now, testdienst.service]

conditions.message: All of the VMI's DVs are bound and ready
cannot migrate VMI: PVC referenzvm-disk is not shared, live migration requires that all PVCs must be shared (using ReadWriteMany access mode)
